skill.name: skills-factory
skill.description: Create, validate, package, and deploy Claude Code skills with structured workflows, evaluation guidance, validation scripts, and deployment references.
skill.summary: Guides creation, validation, packaging, and deployment of Claude Code skills.
skill.author: DaronVee

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are documentation examples, Markdown formatting, or expected Claude Code skill path references. The remaining real issues are local packaging and installation behaviors that can include unintended files or persist reviewed skills into Claude Code directories. No prompt injection text was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Archive packaging can include unintended files.
remediation.suggestion: Skip symlinks, ignore hidden or generated artifacts by default, and require an allowlist for packaged paths.

remediation.issue: Install overwrite removes an existing skill directory.
remediation.suggestion: Show the resolved target path and require exact skill name confirmation before calling shutil.rmtree.

remediation.issue: Deployment examples include direct delete and install commands.
remediation.suggestion: Add safety notes before delete and install examples so users verify resolved paths before running commands.

content.value_statement: Creating reusable AI skills is hard to structure, test, and package. Skills Factory guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through skill design, validation, iteration, and deployment.
actual_capabilities: Generates starter skill folders with SKILL.md, scripts, references, and assets placeholders.
Validates YAML frontmatter, naming rules, references, scripts, and workflow structure.
Packages skills into zip files for Claude.ai, Claude Desktop, or API distribution.
Installs skills into personal or project Claude Code skill directories when requested.
Provides evaluation, troubleshooting, deployment, and workflow pattern references.
limitations: Validation is heuristic and cannot prove a skill is safe or effective.
Scripts require Python and local filesystem access.
Deployment examples require user supplied API credentials.
Generated starter content still needs domain-specific writing and review.

use_cases.title: Create a New Skill
use_cases.description: Scaffold a focused Claude Code skill with clear triggers, structure, references, and validation steps.

use_cases.title: Review a Team Skill
use_cases.description: Check an existing skill for YAML quality, progressive disclosure, script references, and workflow clarity.

use_cases.title: Prepare Skill Distribution
use_cases.description: Package, install, or document deployment paths for Claude Code, Claude.ai, Claude Desktop, and API use.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Starter Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a starter skill for [domain]. Ask for missing requirements, then propose a clear structure and validation plan.

prompt_templates.title: Validate an Existing Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my existing skill in [path]. Check YAML, progressive disclosure, references, scripts, and unclear workflow steps.

prompt_templates.title: Package for Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Package my validated skill for [target surface]. Explain any warnings and choose the safest deployment option.

prompt_templates.title: Run Iterative Evaluation
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a two-Claude evaluation plan for [skill name]. Define realistic tasks, observe failures, propose revisions, and validate the result.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for release note writing.
output_examples.output: A skill outline, trigger description, reference plan, and validation checklist tailored to release notes.
A review summary of naming, frontmatter, references, scripts, workflow clarity, and specific fixes.

output_examples.input: Prepare deployment for a team skill.
output_examples.output: A packaging recommendation, install target explanation, verification steps, and git sharing checklist.

best_practices: Keep SKILL.md focused and move detailed guidance into one-level reference files.
Run validation before packaging or installing any generated skill.
Review generated scripts and paths before writing into Claude Code skill directories.
anti_patterns: Do not publish starter skills that still contain TODO placeholders.
Do not package unreviewed files, secrets, or large generated artifacts.
Do not install community skills into personal scope without reviewing their instructions.

faq.question: Does this create skills automatically?
faq.answer: It can scaffold folders and files through scripts, but users must review and complete the generated content.

faq.question: Can it publish to every Claude surface?
faq.answer: It explains separate deployment paths for Claude Code, Claude.ai, Claude Desktop, and API usage.

faq.question: Does validation guarantee security?
faq.answer: No. Validation checks structure and quality patterns. It does not replace manual security review.

faq.question: What tools does it support?
faq.answer: The guidance targets Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows for creating and reviewing skills.

faq.question: Can teams use it?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports project skill locations and git-based sharing guidance.

faq.question: Why are there many security warnings?
faq.answer: The skill documents filesystem paths, shell examples, packaging, and installation scripts, so scanners flag expected behavior.
